honors_and_awards.title: Tapia Conference Gen AI Hackathon
honors_and_awards.description: Selected as an Overall Winner for DocBot, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that helps users navigate complex documents like research papers. DocBot takes in natural language queries, providing users with instant, summarized answers and a simplified way to comprehend key information.

honors_and_awards.title: HackTX 2024
honors_and_awards.description: Won Best Overall Design for BioDex, an innovative wildlife app that uses AI to transform user photos into custom trading cards. Built with React Native, Flask, and Firebase, BioDex allows users to discover, share, and trade unique species while promoting biodiversity through interactive features and gamified exploration.

honors_and_awards.title: Texas Women in CS Hackathon
honors_and_awards.description: Won Best Fintech Hack for OMAR—Order Management and Accounts Receivable—a suite designed to help startups streamline their invoicing, product management, and financial tracking processes. Sponsored by Hudson River Trading.
